_doc: Declarative release channels for the raw systemd fleet. Each box runs hiverelay-updater on a timer; it reads its channel here and checks out the matching tag (health-gated, auto-rollback). Promote a release by editing the target tag and committing — canary boxes pick it up first, stable boxes when you bump stable. Holding a box = point its channel at the version it already runs.
_hold_doc: `hold` exists so an individual box can be excluded from a channel promotion without inventing a bespoke channel per release. Point a box at it with `CHANNEL=hold` in /etc/hiverelay-updater.conf. Currently used to keep the Track B blind public-test hosts off Track A rollouts.
